title: CONSIDER: A. AUTHORIZING the Chief Executive Officer or their designee to execute Metrolink’s second continuing resolution to extend Fiscal Year 2026 (FY26)…
summary: Extending Metrolink's Fiscal Year 2026 budget through January 2027, approving additional funding for the San Bernardino Line fare reduction program, station safety and ADA improvements, and requesting a comprehensive audit of train parts, safety concerns, and Alstom's performance.
